newsitem.title: GHANA: Banks shares mixed on quiet Ghana exchange.
newsitem.headline: Banks shares mixed on quiet Ghana exchange.

text.p: Mixed dealings in bank shares was the main feature of a quiet Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday, with a strong performance from Ghana Commercial Bank pushing market indicators up, trading results showed.
The GSE All-Share index rose 0.43 points to 380.31 and total market capitalisation climbed to 3,282.29 billion cedis from 3,281.69 billion.
Ghana Commercial Bank, the exchange's second biggest equity, rose eight cedis to 720 cedis. Standard Chartered Bank dropped 50 cedis to 5,530.
Offers exceeded bids by 925,400 shares to 84,000 and only 26,100 were traded.
